response: The clinical identifiers for early-stage primary/idiopathic adhesive capsulitis that were previously proposed by expert consensus have not been validated. This means that commonly used clinical identifiers may not be applicable to the early stage of this condition. Clinicians should be aware of this limitation and exercise caution when relying on these identifiers for diagnosis or treatment decisions. In other words, the current understanding of clinical identifiers for early-stage adhesive capsulitis may not accurately reflect the real picture, and further research is needed to develop reliable identifiers for this stage of the condition.
